{{Quote|My name's Azalie. My father owns a corporation on Corellia. He and Drooga are partners.|Azalie|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''father''' of [[Azalie]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who owned a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] corporation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and was partners with [[Drooga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], he brought his daughter Azalie along to one of Drooga's feasts.
